caption:
🔓 Binance hit by a $6.3B attack that blockchain firms link to North Korea. Deposits and withdrawals are paused; Binance says it will cover all losses.
📉 Amazon and Intel sink as AI spending worries hit tech. Tech-heavy funds may have a rough day.
🌐 G20 foreign ministers meet in Atlanta ahead of December's summit.
🇯🇵 Bank of Japan holds at 1.25% and says inflation is near its 2% goal. A December hike could lift the yen.
🕊️ A temporary local truce lets hundreds leave occupied Oleshky.
Would you still keep crypto on an exchange? 👇

Cover: Who took $6.3 billion from Binance?
📷 Shixart1985 (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

1/5 Binance hit by $6.3B hack ($6.3B)
Binance says a complex attack hit $6.3 billion in assets. Blockchain firms link it to North Korea's TraderTraitor.
📷 Satheesh Sankaran (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

2/5 AI spending spooks tech stocks (-7%)
Amazon fell about 7%, Intel about 23% after results. Investors fear AI spending is burning through cash.
📷 BalticServers.com (CC BY-SA 3.0) via wikimedia

3/5 G20 ministers meet in Atlanta (G20)
G20 foreign ministers meet in Atlanta Friday and Saturday. It sets up December's leaders' summit amid deep divisions.
📷 Marc Merlin (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

4/5 Japan hits its 2% goal (2%)
Bank of Japan held rates at 1.25%, highest since 1995. For the first time, it sees underlying inflation near 2%.
🎨 AI-generated image

5/5 Truce lets Oleshky civilians out
Melania Trump-brokered truce lets hundreds leave Oleshky. Residents went months without supplies; it ends Sunday.
